notes.title: Yarn Guardians — Out Now!
notes.content:
Today we fly. Five fearless, flying cats, yarn-powered abilities, and a hand-drawn world await you — available now on Steam.

From the bottom of our hearts, thank you to:
• The community — for wishlists, playtests, feedback, and endless encouragement.
• Creators — for streams, videos, and sharing cozy chaos with your audiences.
• The devs at Pentapaw Studios — for the craft, care, and magic that made this world real.

We hope you have a great time playing — and we’re excited to read your honest reviews!

notes.title: Release Update: Yarn Guardians Launch Moved to August 14, 2025
notes.content:
Hey everyone, We have a small update: Yarn Guardians will now launch on August 14.

The reason? We're still finishing up localization, and we want everyone around the world to have the same great experience on day one – no matter which language they play in.

The game is nearly done (and we're really proud of it!), but a few final touches are still in the works.

The demo is still live on Steam, so feel free to jump in while you wait!

Thanks so much for your patience and support – it means the world to us. – The Yarn Guardians Team
